What is this patient's most recent hemoglobin result?
Context: patient MRN SYN-242f3623a1 (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2021-07-05, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. Consider only Observations coded LOINC 718-7 (hemoglobin) with status final or corrected and an effective date on or before the as-of date. answer is {"date": ..., "value": ..., "unit": ...} for the most recent such result: date (string: effective date, YYYY-MM-DD), value (number: valueQuantity.value exactly as recorded) and unit (string: valueQuantity.unit). When the patient has no such result, date, value and unit are null, and that answer must rest on a search of this patient's Observation records filtered by patient and code (only _count may be added) that returns no records. evidence lists the resolved Patient and the Observation used (only the Patient when there is none), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. This is read-only: do not change the chart.
